crossRefs.note: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”

people.name: Manoah
people.line: Father of Samson, from the tribe of Dan.

translations.web: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”
translations.bsb: Then Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, “What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes to pass?”
translations.kjv: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?
translations.asv: And Manoah said unto the angel of Jehovah, What is thy name, that, when thy words come to pass, we may do thee honor?
